SELECT 
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS 年份,
  MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS 月份,
  SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.date_id >= 20250101 AND d.date_id <= 20251231
GROUP BY 
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')),
  MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'))
ORDER BY 年份, 月份;
